Name: Call to Build
Author: TheWarpriest
Description:
You can order building projects over the phone (build, upgrade, demolish, paint, and move).

You can only do this when Robin picks up the phone (not her answering machine). If Robin is available, she will actually talk with you instead of forcing you to interact with her answering machine, giving you all her building options.

[size=5][u][b]Compatibility[/b][/u][/size]
[list][*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.6 on Linux/Mac/Windows.
[/list][list]
[*]Should work in both Single and Multiplayer[size=2][/size]
[*]Works with all other mods as far as I know.
[/list]
[b][u][size=5]Recommended Mod:[/size][/u][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25417]Smarter Carpenters[/url]﻿ - Perfect pairing! Materials would be taken from chests of your choice instead of needing to have the materials on you before picking up the phone.
[/list]
